item.title: Flop 10 WORST Kirby characters
item.description:
1. Galacta Knight
Galacta Knight isn't cool. He is pink and girly. And I think he is meant to be a boy which makes this even more disturbing. Why would a boy be pink and girly? It's weird!
2. Kirby
I hate kirby because she is pink and has a girly design.
3. Susie Haltmann
Literally a girl with ugly girly long pink hair. If she touches me I will probably get the cooties! RUN!!!!
4. Boxy
Boy isn't scary. It is wearing blush and a GIRLY RED RIBBON!!! A big mouth
